name: The Ritz-Carlton Koh Samui
positioning: Oceanfront resort with suites and private pool villas on a former coconut plantation on Koh Samui, Thailand
best_for: Families who want a kids club and a snorkeling reef on site
Travelers who want a private pool villa with a southern Thai dining focus

facts.text: The resort is set on 58 acres of a former coconut plantation.
The hotel pays homage to its coconut plantation past through the use of coconut and natural materials.
Contemporary interiors have soothing color palettes and views of the garden or the Gulf of Thailand.
All villas with private pools also feature oversized terraces.
Pak Tai serves traditional southern Thai cuisine in a private Thai Sala setting.
Sea Breeze Grill serves freshly caught seafood and grilled dishes cooked over charcoal flames in a casual beachfront setting.
The View Dining is a Mediterranean restaurant at the peak of the resort.
The Ranch is a steakhouse serving dry-aged steaks and fresh seafood.
The spa's signature pre-spa ritual is the Songkran Shower, offered before selected treatments.
Spa Village Koh Samui has a yoga pavilion and a lap pool with cabanas.
The resort is near Fisherman's Village, a Bophut coastal town of old wooden shophouses with a walking street market every Friday evening.
Guests can practice traditional Muay Thai at the resort's ring.

highlights.text: The Swim Reef has over 50 species of marine fish and offers snorkeling and scheduled supervised fish feeding.
Each evening, guests can enjoy a complimentary glass of champagne, red or white wine in the Arrival Lobby with traditional local entertainment.
The Ritz Kids club has indoor and outdoor playgrounds with ball pools, slides, swings and a mini-golf course.
A guided visit to a local market is followed by a hands-on lesson in traditional southern-style Thai cuisine.

considerations.text: Breakfast at Shook! is available for a fee.
The resort lists an ocean swimming pool as seasonal and subject to weather conditions.
WhataHotel notes the remote location requires planning for off-property dining.
